# ActionBar > Reusable hover actions for message and response controls. This file matches the installed `action-bar` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/action-bar.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/action-bar.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` - `lucide-react@^1.78.0` ## Registry dependencies - `button` - `core` - `live-status` - `swap` - `use-copy-to-clipboard` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/action-bar-knobs`: `actionBarKnobs`, types `ActionBarKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/action-bar`: `ActionBar`, `ActionBarItem`, `ActionBarCopy`, `ActionBarMeta`, `ActionBarEdit`, types `ActionBarCopyValue`, `ActionBarContextValue`, `ActionBarProps`, `ActionBarItemProps`, `ActionBarCopyProps`, `ActionBarMetaProps`, `ActionBarEditProps` ## Composition ### Anatomy ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { useState } from "react"; import { ActionBar, ActionBarCopy, ActionBarEdit, ActionBarMeta } from "@/components/control-ui/action-bar"; import { ChatTurn } from "@/components/control-ui/chat-layout"; import { ChatMessage, ChatMessageBody, ChatMessageContent, ChatMessageEditable, ChatMessageRow, } from "@/components/control-ui/chat-message"; const answer = "The deploy shipped the new billing page; two migrations ran and nothing rolled back."; export function ActionBarExample() { const [message, setMessage] = useState("Summarize the latest deployment notes."); return (
{answer} Sonnet 4.5 · High · 9s
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `action-bar` - `meta` - `root`: `data-disabled`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`) ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### action-bar - `--cui-action-bar-hidden-opacity`: `0` - `--cui-action-bar-visible-opacity`: `1` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/kits/action-bar - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/action-bar.json
